parties: Goh Ping Hao; LEAP India Limited
headline: Goh Ping Hao discloses substantial interest in LEAP India Limited under SEBI takeover code
sum: Goh Ping Hao filed a Reg 29(1) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations, signaling a substantial acquisition or change in control position in LEAP India Limited, triggering mandatory public disclosure requirements.
implication: The filing signals a material change in shareholding requiring market transparency; counsel must verify whether this triggers Reg 31 open offer obligations or exemptions, and review contemporaneous stock exchange announcements for parallel filings or condition precedents.
detail: Under Regulation 29(1) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, any acquiror who crosses the 5% threshold in a listed company must disclose the acquisition within two days of the event. Goh Ping Hao's filing indicates a material shareholding event in LEAP India Limited. The disclosure is the first formal step in the takeover regulatory chain; depending on the extent of the acquisition, it may trigger open-offer obligations under Reg 31 or qualify for exemptions. The NSE filing is the official market disclosure.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 – Regulation 29(1)
framework.note: Central: Mandatory disclosure requirement when an acquiror acquires 5% or more of voting rights in a listed company.
Central: Open offer obligation triggered if acquiror crosses 25% threshold or acquires control; exemptions available under Schedule I.
